S88.01.note: The Memory tab name was not checked in WebSettingsModal. The Policy page also links How workspace policy works (apps/web/app/workspace/policy/page.tsx), which needs a workspace admin.
steps: Sign in, open the account menu and choose Settings.
Open the Memory section.
Click the link How memory works.
Check that a help article about memory opens and matches what Memory does.

S88.02.note: The search box heading is Search the help centre in the same file.
steps: Open Settings from the account menu, then choose Help.
Click Help center (it opens in a new tab).
Type a word such as billing into Search help articles.
Check that matching articles are listed and that clicking one opens it.

S88.03.note: The Contact support link in HelpSection.tsx goes to the public /support page, not this in-app form.
steps: Open Settings from the account menu, then choose Help.
Click Raise a ticket.
Type a Subject and What happened, then click Raise ticket.
Check that the ticket appears in the list, then open it and use Send reply to add a follow-up and check that the reply shows in the thread.

labels.text: Attach diagnostics: your build, platform and the last few errors this browser recorded.

S88.04.note: The Report a bug link goes to /support#bugs, a public page. The in-app form is the one that attaches build and platform.
steps: Open Settings, then Help.
Click Raise a ticket, type a Subject and What happened, and read the line Attach diagnostics.
Click Raise ticket and check that the ticket is listed with its status.
Optional: click Report a bug in the Help list and compare the public page with Expected.
S88.04.where: Settings > Help > Raise a ticket (in-app bug report); Settings > Help > Report a bug (public page)

S88.05.note: The plan marks this item as unfinished at mount. The dialog is mounted with hideTrigger in WebChatPage.tsx and WebAppShell.tsx, and the menu item calls it, but I did not test that it opens.
steps: Open the account menu from the sidebar.
Click Send feedback.
Choose General feedback, type in Details, then click Send feedback.
Check that the dialog says Thanks, your feedback was sent.
Open the account menu and click Send feedback.
Choose Feature request.
Type in Details and click Send feedback.
Check the thank-you message and that the feedback type is Feature request.
S88.06.where: Account menu > Send feedback > Feature request

labels.text: Attach diagnostics: your build, platform and the last few errors this browser recorded.

S88.07.note: Sharing happens only when the ticket is raised with the checkbox ticked.
steps: Open Settings, then Help, then click Raise a ticket.
Type a Subject and What happened. Leave Attach diagnostics ticked.
Click Review diagnostics and read the box of diagnostics that would be attached.
Click Download diagnostics, then compare the file and the box with Expected.
S88.07.where: Settings > Help > Raise a ticket > Review diagnostics > Download diagnostics

S88.08.needs: a way to make a request fail
S88.08.note: The reference text comes from the translation template {{text}} Reference: {{reference}}. A tester cannot make a failure on purpose from the app, so this may need an engineer to cause one.
steps: Send a chat message while the service is failing, or use a failing model route.
Read the error line under the reply.
Check that it ends with a Reference: code you could quote to support.
S88.08.where: Any chat reply that fails: the error line under the reply

S88.10.note: The Help page also has a Check service status button in apps/web/app/help/page.tsx. The Composer footer shows Unavailable right now only for a model that is down.
steps: Open Settings, then Help.
Click System status (it opens in a new tab).
Read the overall status word and the list of checks.
Compare with Expected: the page should show when results were checked and show Checks passing or a failing state.

S88.11.needs: a live incident, which the tester cannot start
S88.11.note: The notice appears only when the server health checks fail. The dismissal is saved in this browser under agi-dismissed-service-notices (apps/web/shared/components/ServiceNotices.tsx). I did not find a visible label for the dismiss control.
steps: Sign in and watch the top of the app while an incident is open.
Read the notice text, then click its dismiss control.
Compare with Expected: the notice should say the problem and its status.
S88.11.where: A banner at the top of the app, shown only during a live incident

S88.12.needs: a scheduled maintenance window, which the tester cannot create
S88.12.note: Window text comes from apps/web/lib/server/service-notices.ts (ANNOUNCE_AHEAD_MS, maintenanceNotice). I did not find the exact visible copy, so no label is given.
steps: Sign in when a maintenance window is scheduled within 72 hours.
Read the notice; it should change from upcoming to underway.
Compare with Expected: the notice should give the planned time.
S88.12.where: A banner at the top of the app, shown up to 72 hours before a planned maintenance window

S88.13.needs: a release newer than the last one this browser saw
S88.13.note: The banner depends on the last seen release stored in this browser (agi-last-seen-release). It appears only once per release.
steps: Sign in after a new release is published.
Look for the banner that starts with What's new:.
Click Read more and read the release notes page.
Check that the release notes show what changed.
S88.13.where: Any page after a new release: the banner What's new: <headline> > Read more

S88.14.needs: a model that is being retired, which the tester may not have
S88.14.note: Retirement dates are not visible to a tester without a live retirement. The Leaving text is built in ComposerFooter.tsx from a short label.
steps: Open a chat and open the model picker from the composer footer.
Look for a model marked Leaving or Unavailable right now.
If a chat is saved with a retired model, read the notice that says the model is no longer available.
Compare with Expected: the notice should name the replacement model and offer a way to pick another.
S88.14.where: Chat > the model picker in the composer, and the notice shown in chat when the model is retired

labels.text: Import memory from other AI providers

S88.15.note: The button that opens this dialog was not read from MemorySection.tsx (the open call is useImportMemoryDialog). The save button label was not checked.

Click the button that opens the import dialog, the one titled Import memory from other AI providers.
Click Copy prompt, paste a reply into Paste memories, or use Upload file.
Check the preview of memories to import before saving, with Already saved marked where it applies.

Read Your requests and the Access, Correction and Erasure request types.
Submit a request and check that it appears under Your requests with its status.

Click Change your cookie preferences.
Turn a cookie category off, save, and reload the page.
Check that the choice stays off and that the page respects it.

labels.text: Notice to Data Principals in India.

S88.27.note: The Expected line asks for notices shown to users in a jurisdiction; these are reachable public pages, but the code does not show a notice shown automatically to users by their location (no region check found in the listed files), so a tester reaches them by navigating. The footer link is in apps/web/features/marketing/components/system/nav.ts (FOOTER_LEGAL), and the plan's "Where to find it: not written yet" is outdated. Whether the footer also appears inside signed-in screens was not verified.
steps: Open the public website (no sign-in needed) and scroll to the footer.
Click "Legal" in the footer's legal links.
On the "Legal." page, find the row "India: DPDP notice" and click its link to /privacy/india.
Check that the page titled "Notice to Data Principals in India." shows the itemised DPDP notice, including the grievance redressal section and the nomination note.
Go back to the "Legal." page and open the row that links to /legal/eu-representative.
Check that the page titled "EU representative." says AGI has not designated an EU representative under GDPR Article 27, with the date and where to send privacy requests.
S88.27.where: Public site footer > Legal > India: DPDP notice (the EU representative page is the row above it on the Legal page, linking to /legal/eu-representative)
